items.q: Do I need a referral or a GP's approval to see you?
items.a: No. Herbal medicine and naturopathy are complementary disciplines and you do not need a referral or GP permission. I do ask that you disclose any current medications so I can check for herb-drug interactions — this is a clinical safety step, not a barrier to working together. If you are under specialist care for a serious condition, I will always work alongside that care, never in opposition to it.

items.q: What happens during the initial consultation?
items.a: We spend 90 minutes together (online or in person). I take a full case history — not just your symptoms, but your overall health picture, your energy patterns, your sleep, your stress, your digestion, your history. This depth is what makes a personalised protocol possible. Within 48 hours you receive a written protocol including herbal recommendations, naturopathic advice and relevant lifestyle adjustments.

items.q: How soon will I see results?
items.a: This depends on the condition and the person. Some clients notice significant changes within two to four weeks — particularly for sleep, stress and acute presentations. Chronic hormonal conditions like endometriosis and PMOS typically take three to six months to show meaningful improvement through herbal medicine. This is not a limitation — it is how the body genuinely heals. I will always be honest with you about realistic timelines.

items.q: Do you work with clients who are on medication?
items.a: Yes. Many of my clients are on medication, and herbal medicine works effectively alongside conventional treatment in most cases. I always carry out a thorough herb-drug interaction check as part of the initial consultation. There are some specific combinations I will not recommend — I will always explain clearly if that is the case and why. I never advise anyone to stop their medication without speaking to their prescribing doctor.

items.q: Can you consult with me if I am outside the UK?
items.a: Yes. Most of my consultations happen online, and I work with clients in the UK, France, Spain, Switzerland and beyond. I practise in English and French. For herbal formulations, I can recommend trusted suppliers in your region, or we can discuss shipping options depending on where you are.

I ask for 48 hours notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours notice will be charged at 50% of the session fee. I understand that life happens — particularly when you are managing a health condition — and I always apply this with common sense and compassion.
